task: Compare `enterpriseb2bsolution_proposal.docx` against `b2bcustomer_requirements_research_report.pdf` and list the researched requirements the proposal does not address. Mark which of those were rated important by customers, since an unaddressed minor requirement is not the same problem as an unaddressed critical one. Then check whether the proposal promises anything the research does not show demand for, because unrequested scope is as much a risk to the deal as a missing feature, and a proposal that is simultaneously missing critical requirements and carrying unwanted ones usually means the author never read the research at all.
